paragraphs: The G65 AMG was the flagship of the G-Class range during the W463 generation, fitted with a 6.0-litre twin-turbo V12 — an engine shared with the S65 AMG and other top-tier Mercedes models of the era. Produced from 2012 to 2017, the G65 AMG was discontinued with the introduction of the W463a generation in 2018, which dropped the V12 option entirely in favour of the twin-turbo V8. The G65 AMG is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace M256 engines for every G65 AMG on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the G65 AMG from 2023 to present. The M256 features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older M276 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every M256 rebuild.

compatibility.intro: The G65 AMG uses a 6.0-litre V12 engine unique to the top-tier AMG models. Because of the complexity and the limited production numbers, parts sourcing for a V12 rebuild is more involved than for the more common V8 units. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm:
